	if = {

# Sum of the polls (normalised back to 1000 each month)
wm_polls_total = {
	value = 0
	add = global_var:wm_poll_lab

	add = global_var:wm_poll_ld
	add = global_var:wm_poll_ruk
	add = global_var:wm_poll_grn

# The seat model. Scope: a seat (county title) with var:wm_lean_<party>. Half uniform swing (the 2024 share plus the
# change in the party's poll, times the nation factor for parties that stand in one nation only), half proportional
# swing (the 2024 share scaled by poll / 2024 poll). Tenths of a percent.
wm_election_seat_share_lab = {	# nation factor 1 (stands across Great Britain)
	value = var:wm_lean_lab
	multiply = global_var:wm_poll_lab
	divide = wm_polls_baseline_lab
	add = var:wm_lean_lab
	add = {
		value = global_var:wm_poll_lab
		subtract = wm_polls_baseline_lab
		multiply = 1
	}
	divide = 2
	min = 0
}
wm_election_seat_share_con = {	# nation factor 1 (stands across Great Britain)
	value = var:wm_lean_con
	multiply = global_var:wm_poll_con

	add = var:wm_lean_con
	add = {
		value = global_var:wm_poll_con

# The governing party's poll, and the best poll of any other party (min = X raises the value to X)
wm_polls_government_poll = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_lab
			title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_labour }
		}
		value = global_var:wm_poll_lab
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_con
			title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_conservative }

			has_global_variable = wm_poll_ruk

wm_polls_best_opposition_poll = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_lab
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_labour } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_lab
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_con
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_conservative } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_con
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_ld
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_lib_dem } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_ld
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_ruk
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_reform } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_ruk
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_grn
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_green } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_grn
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_snp
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_snp } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_snp
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_pc
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_plaid } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_pc
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_sf
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sinn_fein } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_sf
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_dup
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_dup } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_dup
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_sdlp
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sdlp } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_sdlp
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_apni
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_alliance } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_apni
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_uup
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_uup } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_uup
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_tuv
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_tuv } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_tuv
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_1
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_1 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_2
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_2 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_3
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_3 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_4
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_4 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_5
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_5 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_5
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_new_6
			NOT = { title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_new_6 } }
		}
		min = global_var:wm_poll_new_6
	}
}
# The government's lead over the best-placed other party (negative when behind)
wm_polls_government_lead = {
	value = wm_polls_government_poll
	subtract = wm_polls_best_opposition_poll
}

# Seats held by parties that won any (for a sum check)
wm_election_total_seats = {
	value = 0
	add = global_var:wm_seats_lab
	add = global_var:wm_seats_con
	add = global_var:wm_seats_ld
	add = global_var:wm_seats_ruk
	add = global_var:wm_seats_grn
	add = global_var:wm_seats_snp
	add = global_var:wm_seats_pc
	add = global_var:wm_seats_sf
	add = global_var:wm_seats_dup
	add = global_var:wm_seats_sdlp
	add = global_var:wm_seats_apni

	add = global_var:wm_seats_tuv

	add = global_var:wm_seats_new_3

	add = global_var:wm_seats_new_6
	add = global_var:wm_seats_ind
	add = global_var:wm_seats_spk
}
